profile_text.body:
Writer is a for-profit startup founded in 2020 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as an enterprise AI agent platform trusted by Fortune 500 companies, built to help teams execute and scale on-brand, compliant work. Its site emphasizes a five-year track record of AI research and large language model innovation, with a stated focus on transparency, reliability, and control for enterprise customers.

The company's primary product, Writer.com, is categorized as an enterprise writing AI platform and incorporates brand governance, style guide enforcement, hallucination detection, and the company's own PALMYRA language models. The site also highlights pre-built AI workflows aimed at enterprise marketing teams, along with certifications, self-paced courses, and video tutorials covering generative AI and custom AI agent development.

The site's held data associates Writer with 161 legal matters in California, though no specific cases are detailed. Writer also has a presence in the MCP server registry through a connected tool, DocuWriter.ai, which offers documentation generation, search, and management capabilities across 72 tools including an Autopilot feature.
